integrity.degree_basis: Projective toric degree is normalized lattice volume; Li records the classical hypersimplex normalized-volume formula as the Eulerian number.
integrity.euler_basis: Kapranov identifies torus orbits with hypersimplex faces; additivity of Euler characteristic leaves exactly the zero-dimensional orbits, one per vertex.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for alg-geom/9210002 is dated 1992-10-07.
integrity.orbit_polytope_basis: Kapranov proves that a Grassmannian torus-orbit closure is a projective normal toric variety with matroid polytope, and that the generic matroid polytope is the hypersimplex.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The zbMATH/MaRDI record for Kapranov's paper lists MSC 14M15 first, followed by 14L30, 14M17, 14C05, and 14M25.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns generic maximal-torus orbit closures in Pluecker Grassmannians, not arbitrary matroid toric orbit closures.
The projective degree is for the Pluecker polarization.
The invariant formulas are classical; residual novelty risk comes from a possible purely combinatorial comparison of the same Eulerian and binomial sequences.
title: A sharp degree–Euler crossover for generic Grassmannian torus orbits
